task_instance: Install Ruzzy (Trail of Bits' coverage-guided Ruby fuzzer) from RubyGems with clang/ASan compiler flags, verify it with the built-in toy example, then write a pure-Ruby fuzz harness (tracer + harness scripts, per the required two-script pattern for pure Ruby) targeting a small custom MyParser.parse method containing a deliberately injected bug (raises NoMethodError when input contains the literal bytes 'BUG!'), run a real fuzzing campaign, and confirm the fuzzer discovers and reproduces the crash from a saved crash artifact.
tools_used: apt-get (to install libclang-rt-18-dev for libFuzzer archives)
evidence: 1) Installed prerequisites already present (ruby 3.3.6, clang 18.1.3, x86_64 Linux). 2) First gem install of ruzzy failed with 'Could not find fuzzer_no_main using /usr/bin/clang' because Ubuntu's clang package ships without compiler-rt fuzzer archives; installed them via `apt-get install -y libclang-rt-18-dev`, which provided /usr/lib/llvm-18/lib/clang/18/lib/linux/libclang_rt.fuzzer_no_main-x86_64.a. 3) Re-ran `MAKE=... CC=/usr/bin/clang CXX=/usr/bin/clang++ LDSHARED=... LDSHAREDXX=... gem install ruzzy` -> 'Successfully installed ruzzy-0.8.0'. 4) Verified with the Quick Start toy example: `LD_PRELOAD=$(ruby -e 'require "ruzzy"; print Ruzzy::ASAN_PATH') ruby -e 'require "ruzzy"; Ruzzy.dummy'` produced an AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free report and a saved crash-* file, matching the skill's expected 'quickly find a crash' behavior. 5) Wrote /tmp/.../my_parser.rb (toy parser with an injected NoMethodError bug triggered by input containing 'BUG!'), /tmp/.../test_harness.rb (fuzz harness calling MyParser.parse, per skill's pure-Ruby example pattern), and /tmp/.../test_tracer.rb (Ruzzy.trace wrapper, required for pure-Ruby fuzzing per the skill doc). 6) Ran a real campaign: `ASAN_OPTIONS=... LD_PRELOAD=$(ruby -e '...ASAN_PATH') ruby test_tracer.rb -max_total_time=90`. libFuzzer's coverage-guided engine (via a CMP-based dictionary entry 'BUG!') found the injected bug within seconds, raising the unhandled NoMethodError, printing 'SUMMARY: libFuzzer: fuzz target exited', and writing crash-d7fc79f668783e1a2f1e7d0ca467bd25d38f4db8 (bytes 'BUG!G\n'). 7) Verified reproducibility by re-running the harness directly on the saved crash file, which deterministically reproduced the identical NoMethodError/backtrace. All commands, scripts, and the crash artifact are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec/trailofbits__skills__ruzzy/.
